why: The truth records 305 jobs built to an old revision (170 email named no job, 91 traveller already printed, 44 engineering behind), 81 escaped (t416), and all 137 'wrong revision' scrap reports are truly wrong-revision (t417). The analyst's 330 at-risk jobs contain 299 of the 305 missed jobs and 80 of the 81 escapes: the 82 superseded-at-release jobs are the 44 'engineering behind' plus 38 'email named no job', and the 248 mid-job-no-ECO jobs include 127 'email named no job' and 90 'traveller already printed', with 31 not missed (t418). So the finding finds the planted mechanism, a revision that never reaches the job, together with its escapes. The dollar figure is the analyst's own estimate; the key has none.
